title: Dragon Ball’s Biggest Saiyans Need Their Power Levels Tested With an Official Fight
content:
The recently canonized and reimagined Broly versus the non-canon evil Saiyan Cumber is a heavyweight bout worthy of a main card entry in the Dragon Ball universe. The former towered over everyone in his recent movie, and that was just in his base form. When he advanced into his Legendary Super Saiyan form he looked to be multiple feet taller than Gogeta. Then, Super Dragon Ball Heroes dropped and Cumber gave the universe two hulking Saiyans to deal with.

The second Cumber appeared on screen, it just made sense that these two should have a standalone fight. Before that can even happen, the Saiyan must cross the line of non-canon to canon . Once that happens, the two titans will have a chance to decide who reigns supreme in the scaling war.

A Fight That’s Truly Off The Power Scale

The two did technically fight already in Super Dragon Ball Heroe s, but it was a non-canonical Super Saiyan 4 Broly that met Cumber in battle . The fight was brief and didn’t satisfy anyone’s appetite for the matchup, however. Broly shows up to destroy Goku but meets Cumber in a test of strength move instead. The two traded blows, but the fight is definitely not a full-length feature and ends in less than a couple of minutes.

Now, the non-canon Broly is powerful in his own right, but the canon Broly could prove a more even matchup. Top-of-the-line scouters would splinter viewing the power of these two. To start, Broly scaled at an extremely fast rate in his debut fight versus Vegeta and Goku. Both Saiyans used Super Saiyan 1, Super Saiyan Blue and Super Saiyan God in a short time. In each powered-up transformation, Broly stretched his power to his limits and never left his base form .

Initially Broly would take a beating, but just as quickly he’d counter. He even blocked Vegeta’s punches while he was in Super Saiyan God and proceeded to slam Goku into the side of a glacier, while he was also in his red-haired ascension. Once Broly lost control and went to the Legendary Super Saiyan level, it took a Super Saiyan Blue Gogeta to quell the threat, which should be numerous power levels ahead of Broly . He didn’t even get a training session in the same stratosphere to prep him for the Z Fighters’ power, and yet, he made a multiple-years worth leap in a less than a couple of hours.

Why Broly vs. Cumber Needs to Happen

On the other hand, Cumber displayed his impressive abilities before he even got out of his restraints in the Dragon Ball Heroes franchise . The evil power emanated off his body so much that it causes Goku to attack Vegeta. Similar to the Broly fight, he was too much to handle even with both Universe 7 Saiyans at higher power levels. They fuse together and go to Super Saiyan Blue Vegito, and Cumber still fights them at his base level before powering up into his own Golden Great Ape form that looks like a cross between the Oozaru and Super Saiyan 3.

A matchup featuring with Broly in his legendary state and Cumber in Golden Great Ape might not get topped in terms of power. The two giants are rare birds, because they can compete with the best in the world while staying in lower forms. Another fun, offshoot of this story would be to involve the non-canon Broly in this fight, whether it be in an unofficial story or to canonized him as Broly from beyond.

Cumber is known as the Evil Saiyan, but there is no doubt that the original Broly was the first to be known as a supremely evil Saiyan . His lack of care for anyone around him and insatiable appetite for devastation and violence would make for a fun exercise of trying to discovering who the bigger maniac is of the two. The new Broly acts more as a foil to Cumber which works too, but seeing the two most evil from technically non-existent canons would be fun in an official clash. What do you think? Should these Dragon Ball titans match up in any of the universes? Let us know in the comments.

title: AniBiz Anime Licensing Platform Receives US$6 Million Investment From TBS, Toei Animation, TV Tokyo
content:
Gao is the co-founder and president of Nakama. Nakama launched AniBiz on July 2.

AniBiz is described as "the first dedicated B2B [Business-to-Business] marketplace built specifically for the global anime industry." AniBiz's website states it connects "anime IP rights holders & decision makers (licensors) including studios, production committees, and rights management companies, with qualified licensees such as consumer brands, manufacturers, distributors, retailers, startups, creators, game studios and entertainment companies looking to license anime content and characters." The company stated its database covers "thousands" of anime series, and that its platform and team "make discovery, matchmaking, and warm introductions faster and more transparent than traditional cold outreach or fragmented industry networks."

AniBiz's website lists studios, broadcasters, committee members, and IP owners who are featured on the platform. Those companies include: ABC Animation , ADK , Aniplex , Avex Pictures , CyberAgent , Dai Nippon Printing , dentsu, DMM.com , Docomo Anime Store , Fuji Creative Corporation , FuRyu Pictures , GENCO , Gree , Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures , IMAGICA Infos , MBS , Pony Canyon , Sho-Pro , Takara Tomy , TBS , Toei Animation , TOHO Global , TV Asahi , TV Tokyo , Warner Bros. Japan , YTV , and YTE .

Gao told ANN in July that AniBiz expected to add more licensors over the next few months. Gao also told ANN the service has several tiers for licensees, with the basic tier being free that will let licensees create a profile that licensors can search for. A pro tier that is at launch US$49 per month allows for subscription to the service with access to the data feed of titles, along with production committees and other information. Gao said there is also a third more "bespoke" tier available for companies with special requests.

Nakama stated to Variety the platform "aims to foster new collaborations by lowering the barrier to entry for anyone around the world interested in working with anime IP in both established and developing international markets." Gao told Variety, "For decades, access to anime IP has largely depended on who you know," adding AniBiz "opens the door to entirely new categories of partners… from emerging brands and manufacturers to creators, events, and startups."

Gao also stated to ANN that due to the complicated nature of anime licensing, it is difficult for new licensees to break into the business, and it is also difficult for licensors to find new licensees and "handhold [them] into this process." Gao added, "the ANiBiz platform is basically built with that in mind. We want to streamline the process so that you can bring on new licensees and educate them in a way that you can ... facilitate them joining the anime economy." Gao told ANN, "We just think there's a whole world out there with 10 times, 100 times more licensees than is already in the existing anime industry."

Other leaders involved in AniBiz include Nakama co-founder and CEO Brady McCollum, and co-founder Sae Whan Song . Song has previously worked at Toei Animation , Crunchyroll , and Viz Media .

title: UK Cinema Tickets Available For Irregular at High School Film On November 4 and 5
content:
Some tickets are available for the upcoming Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment cinema release of The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc - ( Mahōka Kōkō no Rettōsei: Yotsuba Keishō-hen ) anime film in UK cinemas on November 4 and 5, in Japanese with subtitles.

The film is listed at Odeon cinemas here , at Vue cinemas here , at Showcase cinemas here and at Cineworld cinemas here , although only one Cineworld cinema (in Brighton) is being listed as of writing. Other cinemas not linked with these chains may be showing the film as well.

The film is described in the press release as follows:

"It is the year 2096. Almost a century has passed since magic was established as actual technology. A pair of siblings were about to enter the winter season of their second year in high school. Tatsuya, the older brother, bears a fatal flaw in his magic abilities. Meanwhile, the beautiful and intelligent, perfect younger sister, Miyuki, has unmatched magical talent. An irregular and a star student.

"Despite their differences, the pair of siblings were living alongside each other in harmony. That is, until they received a certain letter...

"The letter contained an invitation to the New Year's Banquet, to be hosted at the Yotsuba Clan's headmanor. The Head of the Yotsuba Clan, Maya Yotsuba, and the heads of each branch family will be in attendance...There, the next Head of the Yotsuba Clan will be announced.

"Miyuki dreaded the prospect of being designated as the next Head of the Clan. For if she were to assume that mantle, she would no longer be permitted to remain single; she would be required to marry. And that, in turn, would mean having to let go of the days she spent by Tatsuya's side. However, Miyuki becoming the Head of the Clan would allow her to transform the status of Tatsuya—who, as a Guardian, has long been treated with disdain. Hoping to provide Tatsuya's freedom, Miyuki makes a momentous decision while en route to the Yotsuba manor.

""Brother... I will become the Head of the Yotsuba Clan.""

Returning cast members included Yūichi Nakamura as Tatsuya Shiba, Saori Hayami as Miyuki Shiba, Chiwa Saitō as Maya Yotsuba, and Emiri Katō as Fumiya Kuroba. New cast members included Daisuke Ono as Katsushige Shibata and Ai Kayano as Yuuka Tsukuba.

Jimmy Stone directed the anime at 8-Bit . Taku Iwasaki composed the music. Tsutomu Satou is credited for the original story, and Kana Ishida is credited for the original character design.

The staff also included:

• Script: Munemasa Nakamoto (WriteWorks)

• Character Design/Chief Animation Director: Kana Ishida

• Color Key Artist: Sakura Komatsu

• Prop/Gimmick Design: Wataru Inada

• 3D CG Producer/Modeler: Kazuki Amenomiya

• Art Design: Yūho Taniuchi

• Art Directors: Shunichirō Yoshihara, Ji Xin Zhou, Ayumi Satō

• Background Art：Goofy, Studio Naya

• Visual Director/Compositing Director of Photography: Takeshi Hirooka (Nexus)

• Editing: Kashiko Kimura (MADBOX)

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Sound Effects: Yuji Furuya

• Casting Manager: Kumiko Suzuki

• Distribution: Animec

LiSA performed the theme song "YES."

The film opened in Japan on May 8 after an April 28 premiere in Tokyo.

Tsutomu Satou 's The irregular at magic high school ( Mahōka Kōkō no Rettōsei ) light novel series launched in 2008, and ended with the 32nd volume in September 2020. Two sequels shipped in October 2020 and January 2021.

The irregular at magic high school TV anime premiered in April 2014 and aired for 26 episodes. A second season, titled The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc , premiered in October 2020 and ran for 13 episodes. The anime franchise also includes the The irregular at magic high school The Movie: The Girl Who Summons the Stars film, which opened in Japan in June 2017. The Honor Student at Magic High School manga inspired a 13-episode TV anime that premiered in July 2021.

The irregular at magic high school anime's third television season premiered in April 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired with English subtitles and an English dub .

Yen Press publishes the original The irregular at magic high school light novel series and Yu Mori 's The Honor Student at Magic High School spinoff manga.

title: Anime Limited Announces Upcoming UK Home and Cinema Releases
content:
AnimeBluRayUK reports that Anime Limited made the following announcements at its Sunday panel at MCM Comic Con London at the ExCel Centre.

The following anime will be released in Collector's Edition Blu-rays in 2027.

Macross Frontier , pictured right.

Banana Fish , including an English dub

Oshi no Ko Season 1, pictured left.

Memories - a 4K UHD Blu-ray of the 1995 anthology film.

Princess Connect! Re:Dive

Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 1

Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song-

Sk8 the Infinity

The releases of Bleach will continue in 2027, including a third Collector's Set which will contain Volume 10 of the series as well as an art box which can hold the upcoming eleventh, twelfth and thirteenth volumes.

The releases of InuYasha will also continue in 2027, with Collector's Editions of Seasons 3, 4, 5 and 6.

Anime Limited also confirmed that it will release Studio Ghibli films in Limited Edition, SteelBook, Blu-Ray and DVD formats.

Anime Limited also announced the following upcoming cinema releases:

ChaO , directed by Yasuhiro Aoki , will be released from December 4.

There will be a "marathon" of Naruto TV episodes in selected cinemas from January 9 2027, and one cinema will screen an "ultra marathon" on the same date.

The Last -Naruto the Movie- will be in select cinemas on Janury 10 2027

Other cinema releases in 2027 will include ghost – end of night , directed by Shingo Natsume and a 4K edition of Ninja Scroll by Yoshiaki Kawajiri .

title: Crunchyroll India Adds All Episodes of One Piece Anime
content:
The company added the first 325 episodes of the One Piece anime in India on September 24.

Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well. Crunchyroll began streaming the English dub of the arc (from episode 1156) in India beginning on Tuesday.

Toei Animation and One Piece anime producer Ryūta Koike announced in October 2025 that the main anime is reducing its annual episode output to a maximum of 26 episodes moving forward starting in 2026. Following the conclusion of the Egghead arc last year, the anime took a three-month production hiatus from January-March 2026. The anime returned in April 2026 for the first of two cours (quarters of a year) with the start of the new Elbaph arc.

According to Toei Animation , the new schedule allows episodes to "incorporate more content, tempo, and pacing of the manga while continuing to leverage the unique storytelling that is only possible with animation." Historically, with only few exceptions, the anime has aired most weeks since its premiere in 1999. However, the pace has slowed considerably over the years.

The Egghead arc in the anime debuted in January 2024 and Crunchyroll began streaming it in India in April 2024. Crunchyroll added episodes 892-1077 of the anime in India in September 2023 and began streaming episode 1078 onwards from October 2023. It began streaming the English dub of episodes 1144–1155 from the Egghead arc on March 24. Crunchyroll added the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the Egghead arc on March 30.

The ongoing anime adaptation of Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga premiered in 1999.

Netflix added the 2014 special edition of the 2008 One Piece: Episode of Chopper + Fuyu ni Saku, Kiseki no Sakura anime film, the One Piece: Strong World anime film, and the One Piece Film Z anime in India in early 2024. The streaming service added the One Piece Film Gold anime movie in India in January 2024. It added the One Piece Film Red anime in India in December 2023. The film opened in India in October 2022.

Voice actors Kappei Yamaguchi (voice of Usopp) and Hiroaki Hirata (voice of Sanji) attended Mumbai Comic-Con as part of the anime's cast in April 2025.

Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well. Crunchyroll began streaming the English dub of the arc (from episode 1156) in India beginning on Tuesday.

Toei Animation and One Piece anime producer Ryūta Koike announced in October 2025 that the main anime is reducing its annual episode output to a maximum of 26 episodes moving forward starting in 2026. Following the conclusion of the Egghead arc last year, the anime took a three-month production hiatus from January-March 2026. The anime returned in April 2026 for the first of two cours (quarters of a year) with the start of the new Elbaph arc.

According to Toei Animation , the new schedule allows episodes to "incorporate more content, tempo, and pacing of the manga while continuing to leverage the unique storytelling that is only possible with animation." Historically, with only few exceptions, the anime has aired most weeks since its premiere in 1999. However, the pace has slowed considerably over the years.

The Egghead arc in the anime debuted in January 2024 and Crunchyroll began streaming it in India in April 2024. Crunchyroll added episodes 892-1077 of the anime in India in September 2023 and began streaming episode 1078 onwards from October 2023. It began streaming the English dub of episodes 1144–1155 from the Egghead arc on March 24. Crunchyroll added the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the Egghead arc on March 30.
The ongoing anime adaptation of Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga premiered in 1999.

Netflix added the 2014 special edition of the 2008 One Piece: Episode of Chopper + Fuyu ni Saku, Kiseki no Sakura anime film, the One Piece: Strong World anime film, and the One Piece Film Z anime in India in early 2024. The streaming service added the One Piece Film Gold anime movie in India in January 2024. It added the One Piece Film Red anime in India in December 2023. The film opened in India in October 2022.
Voice actors Kappei Yamaguchi (voice of Usopp) and Hiroaki Hirata (voice of Sanji) attended Mumbai Comic-Con as part of the anime's cast in April 2025.

title: R!N (Gemie) Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content:
Singer May Nakabayashi , best known as the singing voice of Macross Frontier 's Sheryl Nome under her stage name May'n , will be the headliner for the 2027 event and the event will also host voice actor Kanna Nakamura as a guest. The event will host Love Live! Sunshine!! voice actress Kanako Takatsuki as a guest. DJ and THE IDOLM@STER voice actress Eriko Nakamura will perform at the event. It will host musician Lotus Juice and the artist's performance will be on January 10 at 6:00 p.m. IST. Asaka , Kanapon, and Nanometer will also perform at the event.

The staff describes the event:

Since its inception in 2005, Japan Habba has been at the forefront of promoting Indo-Japanese cultural exchange. The event serves as a platform for enthusiasts to experience the essence of Japan and connect with like-minded individuals.

The Japan Habba 2025 event took place on January 12 and hosted controversial mascot character Chiitan, a Hello Kitty mascot, idol group Nanometer, musical ensemble Ryoma Quartet, and musician Kanapon. The event also included anime screenings, a manga workshop, "Light Novel Title Mad Libs," a karaoke competition, yukata wearing activity, a Japanese cinema seminar, as well as several Japanese food stalls. The cosplay events included a cosplay showcase, a " cosplay chess" event, and a dedicated gaming tournament for cosplayers .

The 2023 event hosted a Tech & Jobs Fair on May 13 and a Cultural Festival on May 14 at the National Science Seminar Complex and Satish Dhawan Auditorium, Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. It hosted a seminar titled "The Greatest Artistic Movement in Anime," which spoke of the moe movement and drew on the works of Patrick Galbraith and Eiji Ootsuka. The Animathon quiz had over 200 participants and team "Cardcaptor Sakuga" won the grand prize. Finalists in the quiz won Bocchi the Rock! keychains. The Cultural Festival also had a cosplay showcase, Pokémon Go event, and Smash Bros Ultimate tournament. Tomokuni Terukina, "a sanshin master of the Afuso-ryu school," performed on stage on May 14. The event featured stalls selling anime and manga merchandise as well as activities involving tea ceremony, calligraphy, ikebana, and origami, and traditional Japanese food.
author: ANN

title: Detective Conan 2-Hour Anime Special Opens in Theaters in Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia in November
content:
Odex announced on Friday that its screening of Detective Conan: 30-gō Satsujin Jiken (The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30) , the franchise 's first new two-hour special in 10 years, will open in Singapore on November 14, and in the Philippines on November 7. Screenings in Singapore will be exclusive to Golden Village Cinemas, while the Philippine screenings will be exclusive to SM Cinemas.

Indonesian film distributor CBI Pictures also announced that Odex will open the film in Indonesia on November 11.

Malaysian cinema chain GSC Movies also announced that the special will open in Malaysia, but it does not yet have a release dates.

The special debuted in Japan on September 25.

In the special, Conan and the others take on a threat to the nation — the release of counterfeit bills. They visit the National Printing Bureau in Nagano, and then Conan and Heiji head to Osaka where the counterfeit bills were apparently printed.

Gōshō Aoyama launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shounen Sunday magazine in 1994. The manga has spawned a television anime that has been running since January 1996, as well as an accompanying anime film series.

The manga series centers on Conan Edogawa, the alias of detective Shinichi Kudo, whose body shrunk after being poisoned at the beginning of the story. Together with detective Kogoro Mori and his daughter Ran, Conan helps the police solve difficult mysteries.

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Anime Film Opens in Taiwan on November 20
content:
MediaLink International announced on Monday that it will open Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, in Taiwan on November 20.

MediaLink International will also screen the first Expelled from Paradise film in 4K in Taiwan on November 6.

Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance will open in Japan on November 13. The franchise is also spawning a new game titled Expelled from Paradise -The Stellar Angel- ( Rakuen Tsuihō -The Stellar Angel- ) with an original story that will launch on November 26 for Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam .

While the original announcement of the film had featured the title Rakuen Tsuihō : Libera ted from Paradise , a later announcement listed the title as Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance as well as Rakuen Tsuihō: Kokoro no Resonance instead.

The cast members are:

• Ayane Sakura as Gabriel

• Saori Hayami as Alma

• Yoshino Aoyama as Danel

• Sally Amaki as Raguel

• Sumire Morohoshi as Penem

Rie Kugimiya reprises her role as Angela Balzac in the film.

The film reunites the main staff of Expelled from Paradise , including director Seiji Mizushima , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , character designer Masatsugu Saitō , and composer NARASAKI . Toei Animation is producing the animation.

The other staff members include:

• Mechanical Designers: Kanetake Ebikawa, Junya Ishigaki, Takayuki Yanase

• Animation Supervisor: Naoki Ogita

• Modeling Supervisor: Kento Kume

• Mecha Modeling Lead: Toyokazu Hashimoto

• Producer: Kōichi Ioguchn

Expelled from Paradise debuted in 13 theaters in Japan in November 2014, and sold 110,000 tickets. The film's Blu-ray Disc and DVD release in Japan sold more than 70,000 copies. The film won the Best Animation of the Year Award at the 24th Japan Movie Critics Awards in May 2015.

The film returned to theaters in Japan in November 2024 in 4K resolution as Expelled from Paradise -Impelled by 10th Anniversary- to commemorate the film's 10-year anniversary.
author: ANN

title: QCinema Film Festival Screens We Are Aliens, Perfect Blue Anime Films
content:
The festival will screen films at Gateway Cineplex 18, Robinsons Galleria, TriNoma, Fisher Box Office, and SM City Fairview from November 13 to 22.

Kōhei Kadowaki and NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film

centers on Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, two boys who as elementary school students became close friends, but jealousy and misunderstandings eventually drove them apart. Years have passed and the two boys have gone in different directions in life. But when the memories from their past come back, they must face what happened between them years ago.

The film stars Ryōta Bandō ( Fureru. , live-action How to Train Your Dragon's Japanese dub ) as Tsubasa, and Amane Okayama ( Blue Giant , live-action I’’s , Hirayasumi ) as Gyōtarō, when both characters are young adults. Child actors Yūto Maki and Tasuku Nakagome — who were both selected through auditions — voice Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, respectively, when they were younger. Other cast members include Sakurazaka46 idol group member Ten Yamasaki as Konatsu, comedian Kemuri Matsui as Batahara, Gaku Sano as Tsubasa's friend Seiya Toda, Reika Ōzeki as young Seiya, Arisa Sasaki as Toda's friend Elmo Matsushita, and Edo Harumi as a calligraphy teacher.

We Are Aliens opened in Japan on September 15. The film screened at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival on May 14, and screened in competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, which ran from June 21 to 27. The Melbourne International Film Festival (MIFF), the New Zealand International Film Festival (NZIFF), and the "Japanese Animation Special: Masterpieces of Madness, Exhilarating Prospects 12+1" category of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF) also screened the film. Ottawa International Animation Festival awarded the film the Grand Prize for Animated Feature last month.

Kadowaki, who created the second BEASTARS season's ending sequence and music videos for YOASOBI , served as the film's planner, scriptwriter, director, storyboard artist, and editor. Yaffle — who previously produced music for Fujii Kaze, Kenshi Yonezu , and others — composed the music. NOTHING NEW planned and produced the film, and French studio Miyu Productions ( Ghost Cat Anzu , A New Dawn ) collaborated on the production, after joining on the project in June 2025. Artist adieu performs the film's theme song "Sasakure" (Split).

Kon based his Perfect Blue anime film on Yoshikazu Takeuchi 's Perfect Blue: Complete Metamorphosis novel.
author: ANN
